```{r}
OUTPUT_FILE <- "all_tf_orthogroups_consolidated.csv"

cat("Step 1: Collecting POSSVM orthogroup files...\n")

# 查找所有 orthology_groups.csv 文件
og_files <- list.files(
    path = POSSVM_DIR,
    pattern = "\\.ortholog_groups\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = FALSE
)

cat(sprintf("Found %d orthogroup files\n", length(og_files)))

if (length(og_files) == 0) {
    stop("No orthogroup files found in ", POSSVM_DIR)
}
cat(paste(head(basename(og_files), 5), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
```

```{r}
all_orthogroups <- list()

for (i in seq_along(og_files)) {
    
    file_path <- og_files[i]
    file_name <- basename(file_path)
    
    # 提取 TF 家族和 cluster 信息（从文件名）
    # 假设文件名格式：AF-4.cluster_1.orthology_groups.csv
    tf_cluster <- str_remove(file_name, "\\.filtered\\.ortholog_groups\\.csv$")
    
    # 读取文件
    tryCatch({
        og_data <- read_tsv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
        
        # 添加来源信息
        og_data$source_file <- file_name
        og_data$tf_cluster <- tf_cluster
        og_data$reference_support = as.character(og_data$reference_support)
        og_data$orthogroup_support = as.character(og_data$orthogroup_support)
        all_orthogroups[[i]] <- og_data
    }, error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("\nWarning: Failed to read %s:  %s\n", file_name, e$message))
    })
}

# 合并所有数据
combined_og <- bind_rows(all_orthogroups)
cat(sprintf("Total entries:  %d\n", nrow(combined_og)))
cat(sprintf("Unique genes:    %d\n", n_distinct(combined_og$gene)))
cat(sprintf("Unique orthogroups (raw): %d\n\n", n_distinct(combined_og$orthogroup)))
```

```{r}
og_extracted <- combined_og %>%
    select(gene, orthogroup, source_file, tf_cluster)

# 解析 orthogroup 列
# 格式:  AF-4.cluster_1.0:Aff1/Aff2/Aff3/Aff4
# 需要提取:  TF家族 (AF-4), cluster (cluster_1), OG编号 (. 0), 基因名 (Aff1/Aff2/Aff3/Aff4)

og_parsed <- og_extracted %>%
    mutate(
        # 提取 TF 家族名称（第一个点之前）
        tf_family = str_extract(orthogroup, "^[^\\.]+"),
        
        # 提取 cluster 信息（cluster_X）
        cluster = str_extract(orthogroup, "cluster_\\d+"),
        
        # 提取 OG 编号（冒号前的最后一个数字）
        og_number = str_extract(orthogroup, "\\.(\\d+):", group = 1),
        
        # 提取基因名（冒号后的部分）
        gene_names = str_extract(orthogroup, "(?<=:).+$"),

        # 生成新的 orthogroup_name（去除 cluster 信息）
        orthogroup_name = paste0(tf_family, ":", gene_names)
    )

cat("Step 4: Generating new orthogroup IDs...\n")

# 为每个唯一的 orthogroup_name 分配一个新的 OG 编号
unique_og_names <- og_parsed %>%
    distinct(orthogroup) %>%
    arrange(orthogroup) %>%
    mutate(
        new_og_id = sprintf("OG:%06d", row_number())
    )

cat(sprintf("Generated %d unique orthogroup IDs\n\n", nrow(unique_og_names)))

# 合并回原数据
og_with_new_ids <- og_parsed %>%
    left_join(unique_og_names, by = "orthogroup")
```

```{r}
gtf_suffix = "_long.annot.gtf"
gtf_dir = "./reference_gtf_Metazoa/"
gtf_sps_files <- list.files(gtf_dir, pattern = "_long.annot\\.gtf$")
gtf_sps<- sub("_long.annot\\.gtf$", "", gtf_sps_files)
ungtf_sps<- setdiff(sps_list, gtf_sps)
common_sps<- intersect(sps_list, gtf_sps)
print(ungtf_sps)
df_long$gene<-NA
# Read all GTF files
for (species in common_sps) {
cat(sprintf("\nReading GTF for %s...\n", species))

gtf_file <- file.path(gtf_dir, paste0(species, gtf_suffix))

if (!file.exists(gtf_file)) {
    warning(sprintf("GTF file not found:  %s", gtf_file))
    next
}
mapping <- rtracklayer::import(gtf_file)
transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mapping$transcript_id, mapping$gene_id)
df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- transcript_to_gene[df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species]]

if (sum(is.na(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species])) == sum(df_long$species == species)){
    warning(sprintf("Species %s failed in transcrit, switch to protein", species))
    prot_to_gene<-dic_from_vecs(mapping$protein_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)], mapping$gene_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)])
    df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- prot_to_gene[df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species]]
    }
message(sprintf("Species %s: %d total genes", species, sum(df_long$species == species)))
message(sprintf("Species %s: %d genes unmapped", species, sum(is.na(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species]))))

message(sprintf("Fixing gene names for species %s", species))
df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- fix_gene_name(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species], paste0(species, "_"))
}
for(species in ungtf_sps){
    message(sprintf("Species %s has no GTF file, skipping...", species))
    df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- fix_gene_name(df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species], paste0(species, "_"))
}
for(species in sps_list){
    df_long$gene_name[df_long$species == species] <- sub(paste0(species, "_"),"", df_long$gene[df_long$species == species])
}
```

```{r}
tf_genes <- unique(tf_og$gene)
cat(sprintf("  TF genes to remove: %d\n", length(tf_genes)))
original_og_no_tf <- original_og_cleaned %>%
    filter(!gene %in% tf_genes)

n_removed <- nrow(original_og_cleaned) - nrow(original_og_no_tf)
cat(sprintf("  Removed %d entries from original orthogroups\n", n_removed))
# 统计每个 orthogroup 的基因数
og_sizes <- original_og_no_tf %>%
    count(orthogroup, name = "n_genes")
# 统计单基因 orthogroup
singleton_ogs <- og_sizes %>% filter(n_genes == 1)
cat(sprintf("  Singleton orthogroups: %d (%.1f%% of remaining OGs)\n", 
            nrow(singleton_ogs),
            nrow(singleton_ogs) / nrow(og_sizes) * 100))

unique_original_ogs <- original_og_no_tf %>%
    distinct(orthogroup, orthogroup_name) %>%
    arrange(orthogroup) %>%
    mutate(
        new_orthogroup = sprintf("OG:%06d", row_number())
    )
cat(sprintf("  Original OGs remaining: %d\n", nrow(unique_original_ogs)))

original_og_renumbered <- original_og_no_tf %>%
    left_join(unique_original_ogs %>% select(orthogroup, new_orthogroup), 
              by = "orthogroup") %>%
    mutate(orthogroup = new_orthogroup) %>%
    select(-new_orthogroup)

cat(sprintf("  Renumbered entries: %d\n", nrow(original_og_renumbered)))
# calculate new OG range
og_numbers <- as.integer(str_extract(unique_original_ogs$new_orthogroup, "\\d+"))
cat(sprintf("  New OG range: OG:%06d to OG:%06d\n", min(og_numbers), max(og_numbers)))
```

```{r}
next_og_number <- max(og_numbers) + 1

# 创建 TF orthogroup 映射
unique_tf_ogs <- tf_og %>%
    distinct(orthogroup, orthogroup_name) %>%
    arrange(orthogroup_name) %>%  # 按名称排序，保持一致性
    mutate(
        new_orthogroup = sprintf("OG:%06d", row_number() + next_og_number - 1)
    )

cat(sprintf("  TF OGs:  %d\n", nrow(unique_tf_ogs)))

# 应用新编号
tf_og_renumbered <- tf_og %>%
    left_join(unique_tf_ogs %>% select(orthogroup, new_orthogroup),
              by = "orthogroup") %>%
    mutate(orthogroup = new_orthogroup) %>%
    select(-new_orthogroup)

cat(sprintf("  Renumbered entries: %d\n", nrow(tf_og_renumbered)))

# 显示编号范围
tf_og_numbers <- as.integer(str_extract(unique_tf_ogs$new_orthogroup, "\\d+"))
cat(sprintf("  New TF OG range: OG:%06d to OG:%06d\n", min(tf_og_numbers), max(tf_og_numbers)))
```

```{r}
ortho_data <- read_tsv("./Metazoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_conservation_integrated.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 标记 TF
ortho_data <- ortho_data %>%
    mutate(is_tf = grepl(":", orthogroup_name))

# 检查重复
dup_check <- ortho_data %>%
    count(gene) %>%
    filter(n > 1)

cat(sprintf("Total genes:      %d\n", n_distinct(ortho_data$gene)))
cat(sprintf("Duplicate genes: %d (%.2f%%)\n", 
            nrow(dup_check), 
            nrow(dup_check) / n_distinct(ortho_data$gene) * 100))

if (nrow(dup_check) > 0) {
    # 分类重复
    dup_details <- ortho_data %>%
        filter(gene %in% dup_check$gene) %>%
        group_by(gene) %>%
        summarise(
            has_tf = any(is_tf),
            has_nontf = any(! is_tf),
            pattern = case_when(
                has_tf & has_nontf ~ "TF + Non-TF",
                has_tf ~ "TF only",
                TRUE ~ "Non-TF only"
            )
        )
    
    cat("\nDuplication patterns:\n")
    print(table(dup_details$pattern))
    
    # 检查严重问题
    critical <- sum(dup_details$pattern == "TF + Non-TF")
    if (critical > 0) {
        cat(sprintf("\n❌ CRITICAL: %d genes in both TF and Non-TF orthogroups!\n", critical))
    } else {
        cat("\n✓ No critical issues\n")
    }
} else {
    cat("\n✓ Perfect!  No duplicate genes found.\n")
}
```
